verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere exposes a hosted, OpenAI-compatible API endpoint, so a downloadable API spec is a fair ask, but the evidence shows no OpenAI-compatible spec of its own. Probes of all common OpenAPI and Swagger paths returned 404. OpenAI compatibility and the llms.txt documentation index are adjacent features, not a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
